item.title: 200K Context Window——AI's "Memory Palace" Management
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's context management mechanism: 200K tokens isn't "unlimited memory," how it auto-compacts, precisely prunes, and budget allocates. Unveiling how AI manages massive code information within a limited context window.
